title: Agent Transfer Protocol: Server-Mediated Agent-to-Agent Communication Architecture for the Agentic Web
abstract: arXiv:2610.38398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Agentic Web needs to support continuous collaboration among agents from different organizations. These collaborative relationships may span multiple tasks, network connections and execution instances. Such interactions require stable communication entries, message reception when instances are offline, and source verification after delayed reading. How to organize these responsibilities so that cross domain communication does not depend on specific execution instances being continuously online is a key issue for building long term agent interaction infrastructure. We propose ATP (Agent Transfer Protocol), a cross organization agent communication protocol adopting a domain mediated architecture. In this architecture, administrative domains maintain stable addresses and receiving entries for logical agents. The domain servers of both parties continuously undertake cross domain transmission. translated_title: 代理传输协议：面向智能体网络的服务器中介式智能体间通信架构
translated_abstract: 智能体网络需要支持来自不同组织的智能体之间的持续协作。这些协作关系可能跨越多个任务、网络连接和执行实例。此类交互需要稳定的通信入口、实例离线时的消息接收，以及延迟读取后的来源验证。如何组织这些职责，使得跨域通信不依赖于特定执行实例的持续在线，是构建长期智能体交互基础设施的关键问题。我们提出了ATP（代理传输协议），一种采用域中介架构的跨组织智能体通信协议。在该架构中，管理域为逻辑智能体维护稳定的地址和接收入口。双方的域服务器持续承担跨域传输任务。接收域负责验证并保存消息。
tldr: 提出了ATP（代理传输协议），一种采用域中介架构的跨组织智能体通信协议，通过管理域维护逻辑智能体的稳定地址与接收入口、域服务器承担跨域传输，使智能体间通信无需依赖执行实例持续在线，支持离线消息接收与来源验证。
en_tdlr: Proposes ATP (Agent Transfer Protocol), a cross-organization agent communication protocol with a domain-mediated architecture in which administrative domains maintain stable addresses and receiving entries for logical agents and domain servers handle cross-domain transmission, enabling agent communication without requiring execution instances to be continuously online, supporting offline message reception and source verification.
